instrument.name: sa
instrument.label: 频谱仪
instrument.description: 数字中频（FFT）频谱分析仪，0–7.5 GHz；迹线由采样流产生（中频 ADC → 数字下变频 → 加窗 FFT）；高斯 RBW 滤波器 10 Hz–3 MHz（1-3-10 梯级）；四种检波器、三种迹线模式；RF_IN 50 Ω，REF_IN 10 MHz 参考输入。命令集与 SB-SA-1 相同。

components.name: rf_in
components.doc: An electrical input with a resistive (and optional capacitive) impedance to ground.

components.name: ref_in
components.doc: An electrical input with a resistive (and optional capacitive) impedance to ground.

components.name: clock
components.doc: The source's frequency reference: an internal oscillator off by ``ppm`` (hidden; a deviations entry), or with ``source`` EXTernal the 10 MHz on ``ref`` when one within ±10 ppm is there (the internal oscillator otherwise, as a real source falls back when it cannot lock).

components.name: input
components.doc: The input attenuator and overload check (D1 #187): the RF input port is the generic ``input_port`` (50 Ω to ground, the only circuit-layer part of the analyzer). The step attenuator is automatic (reference level kept at the mixer limit, 2 dB steps) or manual; the receiver overloads when the total input power minus the attenuation passes the maximum mixer level. ``out`` is the input attenuated (and amplified by the preamplifier, 0 dB unless declared).

components.name: mixer
components.doc: The mixer (signal-chain.md 5.2): ``out`` is the input converted to the IF against the local oscillator, f_if = f_rf − f_lo, less the conversion loss. What lies below the oscillator (the image side) is rejected by ``image_rejection`` — completely without it, as before; the oscillator's leak (``lo_feedthrough``) sits at DC in the IF frame; the declared ``spurs`` (m·f_rf ± n·f_lo responses) and the distortion products of the mixer's own intercepts appear as further lines; the ``residuals`` are there with no input at all. The output depends on where the oscillator is tuned.

components.name: lo
components.doc: The local oscillator (signal-chain.md 5.1): where the receiver is tuned, the reference its frequency runs off, and how fast it sweeps.

components.name: if_filter
components.doc: The IF filter and amplifier (signal-chain.md 5.1): the analog passband ahead of the ADC — what keeps the converter from aliasing — centered on the intermediate frequency ``if_hz``, ``bandwidth`` wide at -3 dB, and the IF gain. ``out`` is the mixer's output through it.

components.name: adc
components.doc: A sampling ADC with one input and a fixed full scale (signal-chain.md 3.3): where an analog signal becomes samples.

components.name: ddc
components.doc: The digital down-converter (signal-chain.md 5.3): the ADC's samples times a numerically controlled oscillator at ``nco_hz`` — the intermediate frequency comes to 0 Hz — then the decimation filter and the lower rate. ``out`` carries complex baseband samples (``iq``) whose 0 Hz stands for the frequency the receiver is tuned to (the frame's ``center_hz``); a real tone of amplitude A on the IF is the complex amplitude A.

components.name: rbw
components.doc: The resolution filter (signal-chain.md 5.3): the resolution bandwidth — auto: span / ``auto_ratio``, snapped to the model's filter steps and held at or below ``auto_max``; manual otherwise — and the Gaussian filter of that bandwidth at -3 dB, as a windowed FFT.

components.name: detector
components.doc: The detector and log conversion (D1 #187): positive peak / sample / average / RMS / negative peak / normal per resolution cell, then the level in dBm.

components.name: vbw
components.doc: The video filter's bandwidth (D1 #187): auto follows the RBW; the manual value stretches the sweep the same way the old monolith did (its auto sweep time uses min(RBW, VBW)). Steps and limits as the resolution filter's (#616); a ``vbw_max`` above the ladder is the wide-open setting.

components.name: sa
components.doc: The trace and scan engine (D1 #187): the analysis window and its settings couplings, the sweep timing in virtual time, the RF history, the trace modes (write / average / max / min hold), the markers, and the SCPI operations of the display. It reads the analog front end by its wiring: from the IF filter upstream to the input, the lines at the head of that chain and the stages' cascaded noise figure (the analytic evaluation of signal-chain.md 5.4).
